description: We are Harvest 71, a group composed of technology students who aspire to make a great solution to help farmers around the world use existing data to better choose their crops and produce great harvests.
summary:
Harvest 71 is a bilingual (Portuguese/English) website built for smallholder farmers in Northeast Brazil under the Field Shift challenge. It turns NASA climate data DSSAT-CSM crop simulations and local farmers feedback into practical tools that help farmers plan resilient harvests.

Users begin with voice-guided onboarding and mark their farm via GPS on an map with plot demarcation and local well insights. In the crop-planning workspace, farmers can simulate planting windows, compare rainfed versus irrigated outcomes across recent seasons and future climate scenarios, and generate multi-crop rotation calendars aligned with their yield goals using clear visual charts.

For day-to-day field decisions, Harvest 71 also provides zone-by-zone crop quality maps with traffic-light alerts, on-device smartphone leaf photo inspection, community field reporting, all backed by voice narration and high-contrast accessibility for low-connectivity rural areas.
details:
What It Does & How It Works

Harvest 71 is a bilingual (Portuguese/English) website for smallholder farmers in Northeast Brazil. Users demarcate their plot via GPS on an offline IBGE map and trigger a Google Cloud Run backend running DSSAT-CSM 4.8.6. Combining NASA POWER daily weather, NASA NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 climate projections, and PronaSolos 90 m Brazilian soil layers, the app compares planting windows, rainfed versus irrigated outcomes across recent seasons, and multi-crop rotation calendars across 23 crops and 11 calibrated Brazilian cultivars through clear visual charts. For daily management, it adds zone-by-zone crop quality alerts, on-device leaf photo inspection, community field reports and voice guidance.

Benefits & Intended Impact

It helps semi-arid family farmers avoid false-start planting losses and select resilient rotations before investing seeds and labor, improving yield stability and household food security.

Tools, Languages & Software Used

- App & Web: TypeScript, React Native, Expo SDK 58, React 19, Vercel, expo-sqlite, expo-location, expo-speech, Leaflet, @turf/turf, jpeg-js.

- Backend & Simulation: Python 3, FastAPI, Google Cloud Run (Services & Jobs), Cloud Storage, Docker, GitHub Actions, DSSAT-CSM 4.8.6.

- AI USED: Gemini, Claude, ChatGpt.

Creativity & Key Considerations

Harvest 71 combines rural inclusion (voice narration, high contrast, offline storage) with scientific transparency - reporting assumptions, data provenance, and relative yield ranges (p10/p50/p90) rather than opaque single-number forecasts.
